DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) with probable construction-related exposure.

The combination of subacute progressive dyspnea, chronic dry cough, and the specific spirometry pattern of restriction (low FEV1 and FVC) alongside reduced FEV1/FVC ratio, confirmed by the chest X-ray showing increased interstitial markings, strongly points to pulmonary fibrosis. Given your age, smoking history, and construction work, this is likely idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis or possibly pneumoconiosis. I recommend a high-resolution CT (HRCT) of the chest to confirm the extent of fibrosis and rule out other causes.
